subject: Want to cancel my subscription, not happy with the price increase
customer_opening: I want to cancel. You raised the price again and I don't think it's worth it anymore. Please just process the cancellation.
agent_reply: Totally fair, and I appreciate you telling me why rather than just letting the card decline - the price change is a real reason to reconsider value. I won't pressure you to stay, but I do want to make sure you know what you'd be giving up: your saved projects stay archived for 90 days if you change your mind. If you'd like, there's also a lower-tier plan at your old price point with slightly fewer features - entirely your call, no pressure either way. Which would you like: downgrade, or go ahead with the full cancellation? Either way I'll process it within the next few minutes and send written confirmation.
